description: Add a change made outside Fudge to the store’s timeline, such as ads, prices, apps, email, shipping or theme edits in Shopify, so later results can be attributed. Fudge’s own publishes are recorded automatically.

at.description: When it took effect: YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO timestamp. Defaults to now.

links.description: fudge:// references or Shopify GIDs of what the change affected, e.g. gid://shopify/Product/123.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

surface.description: Where: theme, catalogue, pricing, discounts, email, Meta ads, Google ads, apps, shipping or other.

what.description: What changed, concretely, e.g. "Raised Meta prospecting budget from €50 to €80 a day".

why.description: Intent or expected effect, so results can be checked against it later.

name: record_change
title: Record a store change
